english.note: This is the everyday choice for a group or bunch of people, especially an informal or casually identified group.
Use this as the all-purpose rendering for an associated group, including friends or a work crew such as 一班工人.
Use this for a group of people linked by a shared interest or characteristic.
Use this for a casual group of people rather than a set of objects.
Use this for an ordinary temporary group of people gathered for a shared activity, rather than a celebratory social party.
Use this for a group of people considered collectively, including a group being described critically.

examples.traditional: 我哋一班人放工後去飲嘢。
